6.22 rsDataRegionInPageSection
rsDataRegionInPageSection is a critical error that will occur whenever a Tablix, Chart, GaugePanel or
Subreport element exists within either a Page.PageHeader element or a Page.PageFooter element, or
when a Table, Chart, Subreport, List, or Matrix element exists within either a PageSection element
or a PageHeaderFooter element.
